editorial:
Imagine trying to sneak into a high-security hotel room just to get a few minutes of a movie star's time. That is exactly what happens here. You get to follow Josh Safdie as he tries to pull off a secret mission to interview Adam Sandler. The vibe is super casual and feels like a home movie, but it has a lot of tension because you never know if they will get caught. It is a funny look at how nervous directors can get and how cool Adam Sandler is in real life. You feel like you are right there in the hallway with them, hoping the plan actually works.

What really stands out is the raw energy and the funny, awkward moments that happen when things do not go as planned. The pacing is quick, so you will not get bored, though some might find the lack of a traditional plot a bit strange. If you love seeing the human side of celebrities, you need to see this. Just lean back and enjoy the chaos.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up with the actual interview finally happening. After all the sneaking around and the stress of getting caught, the directors actually get to sit down with Adam Sandler. They talk about his role in Uncut Gems and share some laughs. The big payoff is seeing the relief on their faces. It ends on a light note, showing that the risky plan worked and the friendship between the creators and the actor is genuine.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves behind the scenes footage and Adam Sandler.
